verdict.rationale: Jev exposes a documented REST API (POST /v1/systemone, GET /v1/models) with Python/JS SDKs, retries, rate limits, versioning, and a quickstart/playground, and community members confirm they actually obtained and used API access (via OpenRouter and direct). Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and broader third-party API client corroboration beyond a couple of HN comments.
